question: Do maintainers approve the four revised canonical migration paths after a real external-plugin run confirms both the retained imports and the documented owner APIs behave as described?
rationale: The compatibility direction is established by the merged sweep, but documentation now defines the practical migration contract for external plugin authors and the protected label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the documentation demotions once a redacted external-plugin load or `plugins build`/`plugins validate` transcript demonstrates the retained paths and replacement guidance in a real setup.

options.title: Narrow the guidance
options.body: Revise or defer any replacement wording that cannot yet cover the documented use cases without relying on the retained compatibility facade.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the documentation demotions once a redacted external-plugin load or `plugins build`/`plugins validate` transcript demonstrates the retained paths and replacement guidance in a real setup.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged compatibility-sweep history and this follow-up's retained-contract audit make steipete the clearest available routing candidate.
